IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Overstreet, Taylor, Shea, and Buys

Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting the placement of tow truck operators in legal jeopardy in handling unmarked government vehicles.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to tow truck operators' handling of unmarkedgovernment vehicles; and adding a new section to chapter 46.55 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.55 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A registered tow truck operator may not be placed in legal jeopardyof any kind whatsoever for impounding, transporting, or storing anunauthorized vehicle that is unmarked and is owned, leased, rented, orotherwise used by any state or local government. For purposes of thissection, "local government" includes any city, county, or othersubdivision of the state and any municipal corporation, quasimunicipalcorporation, or special district within the state.
